name: json_parser
adaptation_note: project/ holds the upstream files byte-for-byte. Earlier runs of this benchmark used a copy with the json_char alias removed; the analyzer now resolves scalar typedefs and object-like macros and tolerates __cplusplus-only regions, so the alias is deliberately left in place. target.c is derived, not edited: it is json.h with its trailing newlines collapsed to one, followed by json.c with its license block and its #include "json.h" line removed.

derived_files.rule: json.h.rstrip('\n') + '\n' + json.c after its first '*/' with the #include "json.h" line removed
